purpose: Define who can see what, under which gates, before live records or public adverse claims exist.
governing_rule: An access route is not access, and publication eligibility is not publication.
permanent_posture: public record is not public display
access model must not become a police intelligence product
bulk export must preserve correction and rollback
raw sensitive media is blocked by default
family dignity and civilian privacy are not optional display settings
phase_bound_posture: Definitions only; no live access requests, no credentials, no role-gated exports, no public adverse claim publication.
